msg: Start with a random gnome and aim for a harvest of 4 shrooms and above each visit to the forest. Stick with a gnome who gives this rate but be aware that the gnomes harvest rate will change at random so be prepared to swich to achieve the best harvest, stick with that gnome until it falls again. I used the gnome hats as reference only - the colours did not seem to have much impact on harvest. Careful to always hit space on the basket as its easy to forget. Good luck.
